title: Taming Update Drift in Asynchronous Federated Learning via Orthogonal Calibration
snippet: Asynchronous federated learning mitigates the inefficiency of conventional synchronous aggregation by integrating updates as they arrive. In this paper, we propose OrthoFL, an orthogonal calibration framework that decouples global and local learning progress to reduce interference.
